title: Vanilla+ Visuals
description: This pack is carefully curated to enhance the atmosphere without changing the core mechanics.
body:
Vanilla+ is a premium modpack for 1.21+ designed to transform your world into a cinematic masterpiece. We’ve combined the best optimization engines with top-tier visual mods to give you a "Trailer-like" experience without the lag.
 ✨ This project adds:
🌅 Stunning Graphics: Pre-configured Iris Shaders with Complementary Reimagined. Enjoy dynamic shadows, realistic waving water, and soft sunbeams.
🦊 Living Creatures: Full support for Fresh Animations. Mobs now have expressive eyes, fluid limb movements, and unique idle behaviors.
🍃 Atmospheric Nature:
Falling Leaves: Trees shed leaves depending on the wind.
Effective: Adds physical water splashes, ripples, and cascading waterfalls.
Visuality: Sparkles on ores, golden dust in the Nether, and soul particles in the Soul Sand Valley.
🎧 Immersive Soundscape:
AmbientSounds: Bird songs in forests, howling wind in mountains, and creepy echoes in caves.
Presence Footsteps: High-quality, material-specific walking sounds for every block.
🏙️ Infinite Horizons: Integrated Distant Horizons (LOD technology), allowing you to see miles beyond the standard render distance with zero FPS drop.
🪟 Seamless Details: Continuity removes borders from glass panes and bookshelves for a clean, modern look.
⚡ Pro Performance: Powered by Sodium and Lithium, ensuring a smooth 100+ FPS experience even with all visual features enabled.
🚀 Quick Start:
RAM: Allocate at least 4GB in your launcher settings.
Shaders: Already included! Press K (or O) in-game to tweak shader settings.
Resource Packs: Ensure "Fresh Animations" is moved to the top in your Resource Packs menu.
